resources.string: Applies to Romanized Chinese input. Zhuyin has its own scheme. Your selection is kept when Chinese conversion is off.
Tone keys at the end of a syllable: - (1st), / (2nd), < (3rd), \\ (4th). For example, hao< and ni<hao<. Tones may be omitted; apostrophes separate syllables.

When enabled, ; , . can mark the 1st, 3rd and 4th tones after a syllable. These marks may then be interpreted as tones in Terra Chinese candidates. > is not a tone key. Literal input and other language engines keep their own rules.
